modmenu.descriptionTranslation.nightshad: A modular, performance-focused PvP client for Fabric.
nightshade.tour.body.0: A quick tour of the essentials - about 20 seconds. You can skip it at any time.
nightshade.tour.body.1: Your recent worlds and servers live here. Double-click one to play, or switch between Singleplayer and Multiplayer to see them all.
nightshade.tour.body.2: Click your name to switch accounts, add an offline account or change your skin.
nightshade.tour.body.3: Mods shows what is installed, lets you turn mods on or off, browse Modrinth and update everything. The tabs next to it open Client Settings, Cosmetics and your Screenshots.
nightshade.tour.body.4: Press Right Shift for the modules menu. Edit HUD lets you drag your HUD around or pick a ready-made layout, and Custom Crosshair has a full Crosshair Editor.
nightshade.accounts.title: Accounts
nightshade.accounts.offline_note: Offline accounts work in singleplayer and on offline-mode servers.
nightshade.accounts.ms_password_note: Your password is entered on Microsoft's site, never in the game.
nightshade.mods.title: Mods
